1..10
ok 1 a staging area under intent/st does not become duplicate live threads
ok 2 st sync --write does not persist a duplicate id into the committed index
ok 3 threads in every canonical bucket still resolve
ok 4 organize names a collision, finishes the sweep, and exits non-zero
ok 5 intent info counts threads, not directories that happen to sit in a bucket
ok 6 no command re-rolls the thread enumeration outside the helper
ok 7 an mv failure that is not a collision is diagnosed as what it is
ok 8 organize still exits zero and moves cleanly when there is no collision
ok 9 organize does not promote a staged copy into the live namespace
ok 10 doctor reports a duplicate id as a defect rather than an extra table row
